0022600105.text: The Cavaliers have not played a 2026-27 game yet, while the Brooklyn Nets are 0-1, including a 0-1 home record, sit 10th in the East, and are 4th in the Atlantic, 1 game back. Brooklyn will be without Tyler Bilodeau, who is day-to-day with a shoulder injury and is a game-time decision. In the season series, no 2026-27 games have been played, and the Cavaliers won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 106-102 win in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026.
